title: rorca-teams-frontend

userStories.title: Add TypeScript interfaces for Teams, TeamMember, TeamInvite, WorkspaceAccess
userStories.description: Define and export TypeScript interfaces Team, TeamMember, TeamInvite, and WorkspaceAccess in src/lib/types.ts to provide type safety across all team-related frontend components.
acceptanceCriteria: Team interface includes: id (number), name (string), slug (string), createdAt (string), memberCount (number), myRole ('owner'|'admin'|'editor'|'viewer')
TeamMember interface includes: id (number), userId (number), teamId (number), role ('owner'|'admin'|'editor'|'viewer'), email (string), name (string), lastActiveAt (string|null)
TeamInvite interface includes: id (number), teamId (number), email (string), role ('admin'|'editor'|'viewer'), expiresAt (string), createdAt (string)
WorkspaceAccess interface includes: teamId (number), teamName (string), teamSlug (string), permission ('read'|'write'|'admin')
All interfaces exported from src/lib/types.ts and frontend type check passes with npx tsc --noEmit

userStories.title: Add workspace_access CRUD endpoints to backend routes
userStories.description: Implement GET /api/workspaces/:id/access, POST /api/workspaces/:id/access, DELETE /api/workspaces/:id/access/:teamId, and PATCH /api/workspaces/:id/access/:teamId in a new backend/src/routes/workspace-access.ts file and mount it in server.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/workspaces/:id/access returns array of {teamId, teamName, teamSlug, permission} for all teams with access to the workspace
POST /api/workspaces/:id/access accepts {teamId, permission} body, inserts into workspace_access table, returns 201 with the created access record
DELETE /api/workspaces/:id/access/:teamId removes the row from workspace_access and returns 204
PATCH /api/workspaces/:id/access/:teamId accepts {permission} body, updates workspace_access.permission, returns the updated record
All endpoints use AppError subclasses for errors and have JSDoc @swagger annotations; route is mounted at /api/workspaces in server.ts

userStories.title: Add nodemailer integration and SMTP configuration to backend
userStories.description: Install nodemailer and @types/nodemailer in backend/package.json, create backend/src/lib/mailer.ts with a sendMail wrapper that reads SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS, SMTP_FROM from environment variables, and export a typed sendInviteEmail function.
acceptanceCriteria: nodemailer and @types/nodemailer present in backend/package.json dependencies
backend/src/lib/mailer.ts exports createTransport using SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS env vars with sensible defaults (port 587)
sendInviteEmail(to: string, teamName: string, inviterName: string, role: string, acceptUrl: string) function sends HTML email with team name, inviter, role, and accept link
If SMTP_HOST is not set, sendInviteEmail logs a warning and skips send without throwing (graceful degradation)
Backend type check passes with npx tsc --noEmit after changes

userStories.title: Wire invite email sending into POST /api/teams/:id/invites route
userStories.description: Update the existing POST /api/teams/:id/invites route to call sendInviteEmail after successfully creating an invite record, constructing the accept URL from FRONTEND_URL env var (defaulting to http://localhost:5210).
acceptanceCriteria: After invite row is inserted, sendInviteEmail is called with the invitee email, team name, inviter display name, role, and accept URL /invite/:token
Accept URL is constructed as ${FRONTEND_URL}/invite/${token} where FRONTEND_URL defaults to http://localhost:5210
Email send failure is caught and logged but does NOT fail the HTTP request — invite row is always created
If SMTP is not configured, the response still returns 201 with the created invite
Backend type check passes

userStories.title: Add 'teams' to SettingsTab type and register Teams tab in SettingsPanel
userStories.description: Add 'teams' to the SettingsTab union type in SettingsPanel.tsx, add the Teams nav item to the settings sidebar items array, and add the tab panel placeholder so routing works before the tab content is built.
acceptanceCriteria: SettingsTab type in SettingsPanel.tsx includes 'teams' as a valid value
Teams nav item appears in the settings sidebar with a Users icon and 'Teams' label
Navigating to /settings/teams renders the Teams tab panel area without errors
Active tab highlight correctly shows 'teams' when on that route
Frontend type check passes with npx tsc --noEmit

userStories.title: Build My Teams list component with role badge and member count
userStories.description: Implement the My Teams list in the Teams tab that fetches GET /api/teams, renders each team with its name, slug, the user's role badge (color-coded: owner=purple, admin=blue, editor=green, viewer=grey), and member count. Empty state shows 'No teams yet — create one below.'
acceptanceCriteria: Teams list fetches GET /api/teams via apiFetch on mount and on focus
Each team card shows: team name (bold), @slug (muted), role badge with role-specific color, and member count (e.g. '3 members')
Loading state shows skeleton cards (2 rows)
Empty state shows 'No teams yet — create one below.' message with a create icon
Clicking a team card expands the team detail view inline (accordion pattern) without page navigation
Frontend type check passes

userStories.title: Build Create Team form with slug auto-generation and uniqueness validation
userStories.description: Implement the Create Team form below the teams list in the Teams tab. Name field auto-generates a slug (lowercase, hyphens), slug is editable, both fields validate on blur. Submit calls POST /api/teams and refreshes the list on success.
acceptanceCriteria: Name input auto-populates slug field by lowercasing and replacing spaces/special chars with hyphens as user types
Slug field is editable independently after auto-population
On blur of slug field, calls GET /api/teams?slug=:slug to check uniqueness; shows inline error 'Slug already taken' if conflict
Submit button is disabled while loading or while validation errors exist
On success (201), team appears at top of the list and form resets; on error shows toast via ToastContext
Frontend type check passes

userStories.title: Build team member list with role badges and last active timestamp
userStories.description: Implement the member list section inside the team detail accordion. Fetches GET /api/teams/:id/members, renders each member with name, email, role badge, and last active time (time-ago format). Owner member is visually distinguished.
acceptanceCriteria: Member list fetches GET /api/teams/:id/members via apiFetch when accordion opens
Each row shows: avatar initials circle, name, email (muted), role badge (same color coding as TF-006), last active (time-ago or 'Never')
Owner member has a crown icon next to their role badge
Loading state shows 3 skeleton rows
Empty state (no members other than self) shows 'Only you are a member' message
Frontend type check passes

userStories.title: Build invite form inside team detail view
userStories.description: Implement the invite form within the team detail accordion: email text input, role selector (admin|editor|viewer), and Send Invite button. Calls POST /api/teams/:id/invites. Visible only to admin and owner roles.
acceptanceCriteria: Invite form is rendered only when myRole is 'owner' or 'admin' (hidden for editor/viewer)
Email input validates format on blur; shows inline error for invalid email
Role selector renders as a dropdown with options: Admin, Editor, Viewer (default: Editor)
Submit calls POST /api/teams/:id/invites with {email, role}; on success shows toast 'Invite sent to email@example.com'
On API error (e.g. 409 already member), shows toast with the error message
Frontend type check passes

userStories.title: Build pending invites list with revoke button
userStories.description: Implement the pending invites section in the team detail accordion. Fetches GET /api/teams/:id/invites (pending only), lists each invite with email, role badge, expiry date, and a Revoke button. Visible only to admins/owners.
acceptanceCriteria: Pending invites section is hidden for editor/viewer roles
Fetches GET /api/teams/:id/invites on accordion open and after each send/revoke action
Each row shows: email, role badge, 'Expires: <date>' (formatted as MMM D, YYYY)
Revoke button calls DELETE /api/teams/:id/invites/:inviteId; on success removes the row with a fade-out animation
Empty state shows 'No pending invites' when list is empty
Frontend type check passes

userStories.title: Add role update dropdown per member (admin-only)
userStories.description: Add an inline role change dropdown to each member row in the member list. Visible only to admins/owners. Calls PATCH /api/teams/:id/members/:userId. Cannot change the owner's role.
acceptanceCriteria: Role dropdown is rendered only when myRole is 'owner' or 'admin'
Owner member row has no role dropdown (role is displayed as static badge)
Selecting a new role from the dropdown immediately calls PATCH /api/teams/:id/members/:userId with {role}; shows loading spinner on the row during the request
On success, role badge updates inline without re-fetching the full list
On error, reverts to previous role and shows error toast
Frontend type check passes

userStories.title: Add Remove Member button (admin-only, cannot remove owner)
userStories.description: Add a Remove button to each non-owner member row, visible only to admins/owners. Shows a confirmation dialog before calling DELETE /api/teams/:id/members/:userId. Refreshes member list on success.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove button is visible on non-owner rows only when myRole is 'owner' or 'admin'
Clicking Remove opens an inline confirmation: 'Remove [name] from [team name]?' with Confirm and Cancel buttons
On confirm, calls DELETE /api/teams/:id/members/:userId; on success removes the row with animation and shows toast 'Member removed'
Owner row has no Remove button regardless of viewer role
On API error, shows error toast and keeps the row
Frontend type check passes

userStories.title: Add inline team name edit (admin-only)
userStories.description: Add an inline edit capability to the team name in the team detail accordion header. Admin/owner can click the name to edit it in-place, press Enter or blur to save via PATCH /api/teams/:id.
acceptanceCriteria: Team name in accordion header shows a pencil icon on hover when myRole is 'owner' or 'admin'
Clicking the name or pencil icon converts it to an input field pre-filled with current name
Pressing Enter or blurring the input calls PATCH /api/teams/:id with {name}; updates name inline on success
Pressing Escape cancels edit and restores original name without API call
Input shows inline error if name is empty or exceeds 100 characters
Frontend type check passes

userStories.title: Add Leave Team button (non-owners) and Delete Team button (owner only)
userStories.description: Add a Leave Team button visible to non-owner members and a Delete Team button visible only to owners, both at the bottom of the team detail accordion. Both require confirmation dialogs.
acceptanceCriteria: Leave Team button is visible and enabled for members with role editor/viewer/admin (not owner)
Delete Team button is visible only to the team owner

Clicking Leave opens confirmation: 'Leave [team name]? You will lose access.' with Leave and Cancel; on confirm calls DELETE /api/teams/:id/members/:userId (self); on success removes team from list and shows toast

Clicking Delete opens confirmation: 'Delete [team name]? This cannot be undone.' with Delete (red) and Cancel; on confirm calls DELETE /api/teams/:id; on success removes team from list and shows toast
Both actions navigate away from the accordion and refresh the teams list
Frontend type check passes

userStories.title: Build InviteAcceptancePage component and route /invite/:token
userStories.description: Create src/pages/InviteAcceptancePage.tsx (or src/panels/InviteAcceptancePage.tsx) and register it as a route /invite/:token in src/App.tsx. On mount it calls GET /api/invites/:token and renders loading, error, unauthenticated, or ready-to-accept states.
acceptanceCriteria: Route /invite/:token is registered in App.tsx and renders InviteAcceptancePage
On mount the page calls GET /api/invites/:token via apiFetch
Loading state shows a centered spinner with 'Loading invite...' text
If token is invalid or expired, shows error card: heading 'Invite not found or expired', body 'Contact your team admin for a new invite link', no action button
Page is accessible without auth (does not redirect to login automatically on load)
Frontend type check passes

userStories.title: Render invite details and handle unauthenticated accept flow
userStories.description: In InviteAcceptancePage, render team name, inviter name, and role offered after a successful token fetch. When user is not authenticated, show team info plus a 'Sign in to accept' button that redirects to /login?returnTo=/invite/:token.
acceptanceCriteria: On successful token fetch, page renders: 'You've been invited to join [Team Name]', 'Invited by [inviterName]', 'Role: [role badge]'
When user is not authenticated (no auth context / 401 from me endpoint), shows 'Sign in to accept this invite' button
'Sign in to accept' navigates to /login with query param returnTo=/invite/:token (URL encoded)
After login, user is redirected back to /invite/:token automatically
Authenticated user sees 'Accept Invite' button instead of 'Sign in to accept'
Frontend type check passes

userStories.title: Implement Accept Invite action and post-accept redirect
userStories.description: Wire up the 'Accept Invite' button in InviteAcceptancePage for authenticated users. Calls POST /api/invites/:token/accept, shows loading state during request, then redirects to /specs on success.
acceptanceCriteria: 'Accept Invite' button is disabled and shows spinner during POST /api/invites/:token/accept request
On 200 success, navigates to /specs and shows toast 'Welcome to [team name]!'
On 409 (already a member), shows inline message 'You are already a member of this team' with a 'Go to Specs' link
On 410 or 404 (expired/invalid by the time accept is clicked), shows error state matching TF-015 invalid token UI
On other API errors, shows toast with error message and keeps button enabled for retry
Frontend type check passes

userStories.title: Build WorkspaceAccessPanel component showing teams with access to current workspace
userStories.description: Create a WorkspaceAccessPanel component rendered in Settings > General tab (or as an 'Access' sub-section) that fetches GET /api/workspaces/:id/access and displays all teams with their permission level.
acceptanceCriteria: WorkspaceAccessPanel fetches GET /api/workspaces/:id/access using the active workspace ID from WorkspaceContext
Each row shows: team name, team slug (muted), permission badge (read=grey, write=blue, admin=purple)
Loading state shows 2 skeleton rows
Empty state shows 'No teams have access to this workspace yet'
Panel section has heading 'Team Access' with an 'Add Team' button
Frontend type check passes

userStories.title: Build Add Team Access modal with team selector and permission selector
userStories.description: Implement the modal opened by the 'Add Team' button in WorkspaceAccessPanel. Fetches the user's teams (GET /api/teams), shows a searchable team selector and permission dropdown (read|write|admin), and calls POST /api/workspaces/:id/access on submit.
acceptanceCriteria: 'Add Team' button opens a modal dialog with heading 'Grant Team Access'
Modal contains a team selector (searchable dropdown) populated from GET /api/teams, filtered to exclude teams already in the access list
Permission selector has options Read, Write, Admin (default: Read) with brief descriptions: Read=view specs, Write=trigger runs, Admin=manage workspace
Submit button calls POST /api/workspaces/:id/access with {teamId, permission}; on success closes modal, adds row to list, shows toast
Teams already granted access are excluded from the team selector with a 'Already has access' note
Frontend type check passes

userStories.title: Add Update Permission dropdown and Remove Access button to WorkspaceAccessPanel
userStories.description: Add inline permission update and remove access controls to each team row in WorkspaceAccessPanel. Permission change calls PATCH /api/workspaces/:id/access/:teamId; remove calls DELETE /api/workspaces/:id/access/:teamId.
acceptanceCriteria: Each team row has a permission dropdown (read|write|admin) pre-selected to current value
Changing the dropdown value calls PATCH /api/workspaces/:id/access/:teamId with {permission}; shows inline loading spinner; updates badge on success
Each team row has a Remove button (trash icon)
Clicking Remove shows confirmation inline ('Remove [team name] access?'); on confirm calls DELETE endpoint; row fades out on success with toast
On API error for either action, shows error toast and reverts UI state
Frontend type check passes

userStories.title: Integrate WorkspaceAccessPanel into Settings > General tab
userStories.description: Import and render WorkspaceAccessPanel inside the General settings tab in SettingsPanel.tsx, positioned below workspace details and above danger zone. Ensure workspace ID is correctly passed from WorkspaceContext.
acceptanceCriteria: WorkspaceAccessPanel renders in the General settings tab without layout breakage
Active workspace ID is sourced from WorkspaceContext and passed correctly
Panel is conditionally hidden when no workspace is selected (workspace selector shows 'Select a workspace')
Section has a visible divider separating it from workspace details above
Full settings page renders without TypeScript or runtime errors
Frontend type check passes

userStories.title: Complete Teams tab integration in SettingsPanel with all sub-components
userStories.description: Wire all team sub-components (TF-006 through TF-014) into the Teams tab panel in SettingsPanel.tsx, ensuring the accordion expand/collapse, refresh triggers, and role-gated rendering all work cohesively as a single tab.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings > Teams tab renders My Teams list, Create Team form, and team detail accordion in correct layout order
Expanding a team accordion fetches and renders member list, invite form, pending invites, and action buttons (leave/delete)
Creating a team, inviting a member, or removing a member each trigger a re-fetch of the relevant sub-list
Role-gated controls (invite form, revoke, role update, remove, delete) are hidden correctly for viewer and editor roles
No visible console errors on any team management action
Frontend type check passes

userStories.title: Add backend GET /api/invites/:token endpoint to return invite details without auth
userStories.description: Ensure GET /api/invites/:token returns full invite details (teamName, inviterName, role, expiresAt) without requiring authentication, so InviteAcceptancePage can render team info before the user signs in.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/invites/:token does not require authentication (no authRequired middleware on this endpoint)
Response includes: teamId, teamName, inviterName, role, expiresAt, tokenStatus ('valid'|'expired'|'not_found')
If token is not found, returns 404 with AppError NotFoundError
If token is expired, returns 410 Gone with AppError message 'Invite has expired'
If token is valid, returns 200 with full invite details
Backend type check passes

userStories.title: Write Jest integration tests for workspace_access endpoints
userStories.description: Write backend integration tests in backend/src/routes/__tests__/workspace-access.test.ts covering all four workspace_access endpoints with happy paths and error cases.
acceptanceCriteria: Test file exists at backend/src/routes/__tests__/workspace-access.test.ts
GET /api/workspaces/:id/access test: returns array of team access records for valid workspace
POST /api/workspaces/:id/access test: creates access record and returns 201; 409 on duplicate
DELETE /api/workspaces/:id/access/:teamId test: removes record and returns 204; 404 on missing
PATCH /api/workspaces/:id/access/:teamId test: updates permission and returns updated record; 404 on missing
All tests pass with cd backend && npx jest workspace-access

userStories.title: End-to-end Teams tab smoke test: create team, invite, accept, verify access
userStories.description: Write a frontend Vitest or integration test (or manual test checklist in a test file) that exercises the full teams flow: create team → invite user → accept invite → verify team membership → grant workspace access. Ensures no regressions across the full feature.
acceptanceCriteria: Test or checklist covers: POST /api/teams creates team; POST /api/teams/:id/invites creates invite; GET /api/invites/:token returns valid invite; POST /api/invites/:token/accept adds membership; GET /api/teams/:id/members includes new member
WorkspaceAccessPanel flow: POST /api/workspaces/:id/access grants access; GET /api/workspaces/:id/access returns the new entry; PATCH updates permission; DELETE removes access
All API calls use correct Content-Type and return expected status codes
Backend type check and frontend type check both pass after all TF-001 through TF-024 stories are applied
No TypeScript errors across src/lib/types.ts, InviteAcceptancePage, WorkspaceAccessPanel, and Teams tab components

epicOutline.description: Full teams frontend implementation including TypeScript types, Settings Teams tab with team management, invite acceptance page, workspace access panel, and backend gaps for workspace_access endpoints and email delivery
